messages.text: I’m checking the prepared contract and existing response tools, then I’ll implement the isolated gap variant and a reproducible 10k comparison recipe.

I’m applying the repository’s coordination and validation procedures. The variant will move only endcap placements relative to the ECAL root, preserving daughter coordinates and readout tables. The comparison will reuse the frozen primary sample and paired bootstrap policy.

The environment preflight still reports changed setup and lockfile fingerprints. I’ll keep this implementation pass to pure checks; the coordinator will verify the native runtime before constructing geometry or running showers.

The geometry helper now checks the entire XML after allowing only the prescribed signed z shifts. The native helper records every physical placement so the final check can confirm that both endcaps moved rigidly, the barrel stayed fixed, and local material and readout definitions were preserved.

**LAR-GAP10K-SoftEng is frozen**, against input `646b54378fd2d1ae198100174276478509c19e17`.

Implemented the five assigned files under `software/analysis/lar_gap/`:

- Exact signed 400 mm translation of 4,928 replicas and 36 passive roots; preserves 38,210 daughter placements, barrel, world, materials and local readout tables.
- Exhaustive native placement comparison, material/count equivalence and complete 10 nm ECAL overlap checks.
- Two-run comparison with fixed global thresholds, prescribed projections, 1,000 shared-event bootstraps, paired differences, 42-variable width covariance and scientific plots.

**Actual checks:** all 18 integrated pure tests pass; frozen reference bindings and transformation of the actual retained XML pass. No native construction or DDSim ran in this assignment.

Provenance retains the original component exports as `5ef3db3…`, `dirty:true`. The original sample’s producer SHA is `60708dbf990268027c0490309a7a4213c1f7457aa22d6f4df5872ddcdfeb4120`, recovered at immutable `e2222482eb6c267fe1db4e4a871280469d49f7f9:software/analysis/lar_response/transport.py`; this is distinct from its declared generation HEAD. Final `geometry.py` SHA: `99fdc9be01b754971ad6034c6fef0f4df002176e15ae1ee95cdcf10d5b92b55b`.

After committing the clean candidate, run from this checkout:

```sh
work=build/lar-gap10k/softeng
ref=../nodd-lar-10k-response/build/lar10k-resume
barrel_library=../nodd-lar-geant4-placement/build/lar-placement/factories/libnODDLArBarrelPrototype.dylib
endcap_library=../nodd-lar-geant4-placement/build/lar-placement/factories/libnODDLArEndcapPrototype.dylib
audit_library="$ref/audit/libnODDLArResponseAudit.dylib"

python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/geometry.py prepare \
  --reference-sample "$ref/sample" --reference-run "$ref/production12" \
  --output "$work/sample"

software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/native.py snapshot \
  --sample "$ref/sample" --reference-run "$ref/production12" \
  --barrel-library "$barrel_library" --endcap-library "$endcap_library" \
  --output "$work/native-standard"

software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/native.py snapshot \
  --sample "$work/sample" --reference-run "$ref/production12" \
  --barrel-library "$barrel_library" --endcap-library "$endcap_library" \
  --output "$work/native-candidate"

python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/native.py compare \
  --reference "$work/native-standard" --candidate "$work/native-candidate" \
  --output "$work/native.json"
```

Then execute the controls, pilot and production sequentially:

```sh
gap_run() {
  software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_response/transport.py run \
    --sample "$work/sample" --output "$3" \
    --geometry-library "$barrel_library" --geometry-library "$endcap_library" \
    --audit-library "$audit_library" --events "$1" --threads "$2" \
    --seed 133812341 --max-step-mm 5 --reserve-gib 30
  software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_response/transport.py audit \
    --sample "$work/sample" --run "$3"
}

gap_run 24 1 "$work/serial24"
gap_run 24 12 "$work/mt24"

software/env/run.sh python3 -B software/analysis/lar_gap/controls.py \
  --sample "$work/sample" --serial "$work/serial24" --mt "$work/mt24" \
  --output "$work/controls.json"

gap_run 100 12 "$work/pilot100"
gap_run 10000 12 "$work/production12"
```

After successful gates and readbacks:

```sh
plot_python=[redacted]

"$plot_python" -B software/analysis/lar_gap/compare.py analyze \
  --standard "$ref/production12" --candidate "$work/production12" \
  --sample "$work/sample" --native-report "$work/native.json" \
  --protocol docs/validation/lar-gap10k/protocol.md \
  --bootstrap 1000 --seed 13001000 --output "$work/comparison"

MPLCONFIGDIR="$work/mpl-cache" "$plot_python" -B \
  software/analysis/lar_gap/compare.py plot \
  --summary "$work/comparison/summary.json" --output "$work/figures"
```

All output directories must be fresh. Native runtime verification and production remain coordinator-owned; no engineering acceptance follows from this gap-only experiment.
